## 📝 Quiz Generator Pipeline

**Webhook:** `POST /webhook/learnify-quiz`

**Request body:**
```json
{ "studentId": "...", "noteId": "...", "userId": "...",
  "subject": "Mathematics", "topic": "Algebra",
  "extractedText": "...", "questionType": "mcq" }
```

**RAG is automatically applied** — no need to pass curriculumContext.

**Env vars needed:**
- `GOOGLE_PALM_API` credential
- `backendUrl` in Set Config node

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'models/text-embedding-004', content: { parts: [{ text: (($('Webhook - Quiz Generator').item.json.body || $('Webhook - Quiz Generator').item.json).subject || '') + ' ' + (($('Webhook - Quiz Generator').item.json.body || $('Webhook - Quiz Generator').item.json).topic || '') + ' ' + (($('Webhook - Quiz Generator').item.json.body || $('Webhook - Quiz Generator').item.json).extractedText || '').substring(0, 300) }] } }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ embedding: $json.embedding?.values || [], limit: 5, subject: ($('Webhook - Quiz Generator').item.json.body || $('Webhook - Quiz Generator').item.json).subject, topic:   ($('Webhook - Quiz Generator').item.json.body || $('Webhook - Quiz Generator').item.json).topic, curriculumType: ($('Webhook - Quiz Generator').item.json.body || $('Webhook - Quiz Generator').item.json).curriculumType || 'WAEC' }) }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { success: true, message: 'Quiz generated and saved', data: $json } }}
